record.title: Validate a divergent legacy dialect
record.intent: Pressure-test import and currency with a third, structurally divergent specimen in a disposable test repository.
requirements: Record a versioned adapter, exact source provenance, contract identities and historical evidence; a fixture or isolated extraction is sufficient.
This is taskctl compatibility work using isolated specimens or fixtures. Operational adoption, copied-tool retirement and consumer integration remain tasks owned by each consumer repository.
acceptance: Reviewed import and ordinary command use preserve semantics, and any model mismatch is resolved or explicitly blocks the protocol checkpoint.
Preserve the recorded prerequisite gates; this task does not itself authorize consumer migration, protocol freeze or service implementation.
